id: Item Shop.\nWe have something for anyone!
en: Item Shop.\nWe have something for anyone!
it: Negozio di Strumenti.\nAbbiamo qualcosa per tutti!

id: \rI hate when it rains. My hair gets all wet.
en: \rI hate when it rains. My hair gets all wet.
it: \rOdio quando piove. Mi si bagnano tutti i capelli.

id: \bSorry, are my Eevee blocking the way?
en: \bSorry, are my Eevee blocking the way?
it: \bScusa, i miei Eevee ti bloccano la strada?

id: \bSpeaking of, which one do you like best? Splashy, Flamey, or Zappy?
en: \bSpeaking of, which one do you like best? Splashy, Flamey, or Zappy?
it: \bA proposito, quale ti piace di più? Splashy, Flamey o Zappy?

id: \bYes, I thought the same. Take these for your troubles.
en: \bYes, I thought the same. Take these for your troubles.
it: \bSì, lo pensavo anch'io. Prendi questi per il disturbo.

id: \bSplashy, Flamey, Zappy, work hard and grow stronger.
en: \bSplashy, Flamey, Zappy, work hard and grow stronger.
it: \bSplashy, Flamey, Zappy, impegnatevi e diventate più forti.

id: Malie City\nEnjoy the enticing Eastern influence.
en: Malie City\nEnjoy the enticing Eastern influence.

id: \rHave you tried the gym out? It's a one-of-a-kind experience.
en: \rHave you tried the gym out? It's a one-of-a-kind experience.
it: \rHai già provato la Palestra? È un'esperienza unica nel suo genere.

id: \rWant to trade it for my Happiny?
en: \rWant to trade it for my Happiny?

id: \rYou don't want to trade? Aw, you suck.
en: \rYou don't want to trade?  Aw, you suck.
it: \rNon vuoi fare lo scambio?  Uffa, che antipatico.

id: \bDo you like it even more now?
en: \bDo you like it even more now?
it: \bE adesso ti piace ancora di più?

id: \rThis town is inspired off of some town in a far away land. I'm sure you've never heard of it.
en: \rThis town is inspired off of some town in a far away land. I'm sure you've never heard of it.
it: \rQuesta città si ispira a una città di una terra lontana. Sono sicura che non ne hai mai sentito parlare.
